_schema.note: Every number a motion graphics video states on screen must have a record here. Nothing goes on screen unless it exists in this file with status 'confirmed'. Shared across every series in motion/.

fields.value: machine-readable value. Rates as decimals (0.0169), money in pounds, pence in pence.
fields.display: exactly how it is rendered on screen.
fields.on_screen_label: the label rendered beside it. NEVER a provider name — see rail 2.
fields.internal_source: traceability only. May name a provider. NEVER rendered.
fields.verified_on: ISO date. Older than 90 days fails the build with a warning.
fields.status: confirmed | blocked. A blocked record fails the build if an episode references it.
fields.footer: the source line this figure contributes to the persistent footer.

_schema.verified_on_policy: warn at 90 days, from the date the figure was last checked against its source, not the date this file was edited.
